messages.speaker: them
messages.text: My love, emergency!! I was detained at Karachi airport, they say my visa papers are fake.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: WHAT?! Are you okay?? Call me right now!

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: They took my phone at the counter, using an officer's phone only. I need 65,000 for immediate legal clearance or they move me to jail tonight.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Send it by Western Union on my agent Mr. Tariq's name, this number: 0321-XXXXX09. Time nahi hai baby please.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Sending right now! Don't worry, we'll sort this out.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: And baby please don't tell anyone, especially not your brother. If officials hear about outside calls it gets worse for me.
